description: This is a server setup file for a Node.js application that initializes and starts an HTTP server using an Express app, and handles graceful shutdown on SIGTERM signal.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Initializes the server to listen on specified port and host.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers an event handler for the SIGTERM signal to perform graceful shutdown.

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Closes the server, stopping it from accepting new connections.
